hero.subtitle: Where classical French technique and the soul of Vietnamese cuisine meet, in the heart of Hanoi's Old Quarter

about.title: A Love Story Cooked From Two Worlds
about.body1: La Passion was born from Chef Minh Tú's journey — years of apprenticeship in Parisian kitchens, returning to Hanoi carrying classical French technique and a purely Vietnamese heart.
about.body2: Nestled at 24 Hàng Bè in an 80-year-old colonial house, La Passion is more than a restaurant — it is a dialogue between two cultures, told through each plate we serve.
about.philosophy: Our philosophy begins with an unwavering respect for local provenance. Each season, our menu is thoughtfully reimagined to honour what is finest from the Dalat highlands, the mountains of Sa Pa, and the Central Coast.
about.ingredient: Moc Chau wild mushrooms. Dalat scallops. Wagyu from partner farms. Herbs harvested each morning from our private garden.
